verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֬ית לְאָסָֽף׃ הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- hag·git·tîṯ lə·’ā·sāp̄ har·nî·nū lê·lō·hîm ‘ūz·zê·nū hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Gittith Of Asaph Sing for joy to God our strength make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob
verses.literalPt: Cantai de júbilo a Deus, que é a nossa fortaleza. Erguei alegres vozes ao Deus de Jacó.

verses.original: שְֽׂאוּ־ זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ־ תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם־ נָֽבֶל׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- zim·rāh ū·ṯə·nū- ṯōp̄ kin·nō·wr nā·‘îm ‘im- nā·ḇel
verses.literal: Lift up a song strike the tambourine play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre
verses.literalPt: Entoai um salmo e fazei soar o adufe, a suave harpa com o saltério.

verses.original: תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·‘ū ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš šō·w·p̄ār bak·kê·seh lə·yō·wm ḥag·gê·nū
verses.literal: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon and at the full moon on the day of our Feast
verses.literalPt: Tocai a trombeta pela lua nova, pela lua cheia, no dia da nossa festa.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥōq lə·yiś·rā·’êl hū miš·pāṭ lê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For this is a statute for Israel an ordinance of the God of Jacob
verses.literalPt: Pois este é um estatuto para Israel, uma ordenança do Deus de Jacó.

verses.original: עֵ֤דוּת׀ בִּֽיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗וֹ בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ḏūṯ bî·hō·w·sêp̄ śā·mōw bə·ṣê·ṯōw ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim śə·p̄aṯ lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eš·mā‘
verses.literal: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt where I heard an unfamiliar . . . language
verses.literalPt: Ele o prescreveu em José como testemunho, quando saiu contra a terra do Egito, onde ouvi uma linguagem que não conhecia.

verses.original: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִסֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗יו מִדּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·sî·rō·w·ṯî mis·sê·ḇel šiḵ·mōw kap·pāw mid·dūḏ ta·‘ă·ḇō·rə·nāh
verses.literal: I relieved his shoulder of the burden his hands were freed from the basket
verses.literalPt: Livrei o seu ombro do peso, do cesto foram retiradas as suas mãos.

verses.original: בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ֨ עַל־ מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣā·rāh qā·rā·ṯā wā·’ă·ḥal·lə·ṣe·kā ’e·‘en·ḵā bə·sê·ṯer ra·‘am ’eḇ·ḥā·nə·ḵā ‘al- mê mə·rî·ḇāh se·lāh
verses.literal: You called out in distress and I rescued you I answered you from the cloud of thunder I tested you at the waters of Meribah Selah
verses.literalPt: Na angústia, clamaste, e te livrei; respondi-te no lugar secreto do trovão; provei-te junto às águas de Meribá. (Selá)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־ תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ‘am·mî wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh bāḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’im- tiš·ma‘- lî
verses.literal: Hear O My people and I will warn you O Israel if only you would listen to Me
verses.literalPt: Ouve, povo meu, e eu te exortarei. Ó Israel, se me escutasses!

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yih·yeh ḇə·ḵā ’êl zār wə·lō ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh lə·’êl nê·ḵār
verses.literal: There must be no . . . strange god among you nor shall you bow to a foreign god
verses.literalPt: Não haverá em ti deus estranho, nem adorarás a deuses estrangeiros.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב־ פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ham·ma·‘al·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim har·ḥeḇ- pî·ḵā wa·’ă·mal·’ê·hū
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you up out of Egypt Open wide your mouth . . . and I will fill it
verses.literalPt: Eu sou Jeová, teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito. Abre bem a tua boca, e ta encherei.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־ אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ‘am·mî lə·qō·w·lî wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō- ’ā·ḇāh lî
verses.literal: But My people . . . would not listen to Me and Israel would not obey Me
verses.literalPt: Mas o meu povo não escutou a minha voz, e Israel não me quis.

verses.literal: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices
verses.literalPt: Assim, os deixei andar segundo a obstinação dos seus corações, para que seguissem os seus próprios conselhos.

verses.original: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lū ‘am·mî šō·mê·a‘ lî yiś·rā·’êl biḏ·rā·ḵay yə·hal·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: If only My people would listen to Me if Israel would follow My ways
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que escutasse o meu povo, que Israel andasse nos meus caminhos!

verses.original: כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃
verses.literal: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes
verses.literalPt: Eu em breve, abateria os seus inimigos e voltaria a minha mão contra os seus adversários.

verses.original: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ־ ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·śan·’ê Yah·weh yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū- lōw wî·hî ‘it·tām lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience and their doom would last forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Os que aborrecem a Jeová se lhe submeteriam, mas a prosperidade de Israel duraria para sempre;

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: But I would feed you the finest wheat with honey from the rock I would satisfy you
verses.literalPt: Nutri-lo-ia com a melhor farinha de trigo e, com o mel que mana da rocha, eu te saciaria.
